data.name: 黄泉園（Yomi no Sono）
data.detailed_description:
In a sunken garden, Yomi itself is watching you.

A first-person horror experience where Japanese mythology meets thalassophobia.

―――

Edo-era Japan. A condemned criminal, cast into the river to die.

But the place you awaken is not the afterlife you expected.

This is Yomi — the realm between life and death.

A submerged Japanese garden, entwined with the ruins of forgotten shrines.

Lantern light is your only guide on land.

Below the murky water, vision fails you.

And something inhuman lingers in the silence.

Something stirs beneath the water.

Something that moves the moment you look away.

Ancient yōkai, born of forgotten legends, wait for you here.

Will you carry your sins, or seek atonement?

The path you walk will decide your fate.

Yomi sees everything you are.

―――

■ Features

· Only water and garden, as far as you can see.

No HUD. No text. No map. A fully immersive zero-UI experience.

· No combat. Hide from what waits beneath the water — hold your breath, and look away.

· Your choices lead to one of three endings.

· A 1–2 hour journey. Return again. Witness every ending.

―――

【Content Warning】

Contains depictions of water immersion, enclosed spaces, and unsettling soundscapes.

data.short_description: A first-person horror exploration where Japanese mythology meets thalassophobia. With no power to resist, observe and evade as you wander the otherworld of Yomi. Flee, or bear your karma and seek atonement—your choices shape the ending. Yomi sees all that you are.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
